column1: Consider the pricing decision facing a typical firm. The firm’s desired price p depends on two macroeconomic variables: n The overall level of prices P. A higher price level implies that the firm’s costs are higher. Hence, the higher the overall price level, the more the firm would like to charge for its product. n The level of aggregate income Y. A higher level of income raises the demand for the firm’s product. Because marginal cost increases at higher levels of production, the greater the demand, the higher the firm’s desired price.
